summary: We heard at our semester kick off from leadership, "Minority students now out number white students"....can we stop saying minority then? By definition the majority is not the minority.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: We heard at our semester kick off from leadership, "Minority students now out number white students"....can we stop saying minority then? By definition the majority is not the minority.
